item.item_desc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. requirements.name: Flower of Eternity
requirements.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

item.item_desc: Medal of honor worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards with gallant and meritorious service. Advanced material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: A proof of honor awarded to those that fought against Fragmentum creatures, Underworlders, and sudden disasters. It is not usually pinned onto the recipient's chest, but rather placed onto his coffin. "Remember, young Gepard. It is not a toy: It is the destiny and blood of the Landau family."

requirements.name: Key of Knowledge
requirements.description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. I woke up realizing that this is the answer I've been looking for all along!"

item.item_desc: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. The heart is glimmering and the veins on it indicate it's still alive. "What kind of monster is this? Did you see it... Its face! It has the face of our previous leader!"

requirements.description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: This is the proof of invitation to the halls of the Nous Temple. Finding the door of which this key opens is a far more arduous task than obtaining the key itself. Those who pass through the doors will immediately realize the impossibility of returning to this side. "The Erudition does not have answers to the universe, but it will teach you how to ask the right questions."

requirements.description: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind. Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy. "The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."

item.item_bg_desc: A proof of honor awarded to those that fought against Fragmentum creatures, Underworlders, and sudden disasters. It is not usually pinned onto the recipient's chest, but rather placed onto his coffin. "Remember, young Gepard. It is not a toy: It is the destiny and blood of the Landau family."

requirements.name: Flower of Eternity
requirements.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

item.item_desc: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Advanced material used for enhancement.

requirements.name: Key of Knowledge
requirements.description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. I woke up realizing that this is the answer I've been looking for all along!"

requirements.name: Glimmering Core
requirements.description: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. The heart is glimmering and the veins on it indicate it's still alive. "What kind of monster is this? Did you see it... Its face! It has the face of our previous leader!"

requirements.description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: This is the proof of invitation to the halls of the Nous Temple. Finding the door of which this key opens is a far more arduous task than obtaining the key itself. Those who pass through the doors will immediately realize the impossibility of returning to this side. "The Erudition does not have answers to the universe, but it will teach you how to ask the right questions."

requirements.name: Arrow of the Starchaser
requirements.description: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind. Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy. "The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."

requirements.description: New and young shoot budding from an ancient divine construct. Crude material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: New and young shoot budding from an ancient divine construct. Crude material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "infinite lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. Countless years ago, a sovereign's hubris for immortality caused the Xianzhou fleet to sail into the sea of outer space to seek divine recipes.\n\n"We desire to live for endless ages and maintain the empire for all eternity. Unfortunately, human lives have limits and human capacity has its ends. Thus, we send nine Navis Astrigera to sail beyond the sky, seeking divine recipes for immortality."

requirements.description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

requirements.name: Immortal Aeroblossom
requirements.description: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After endless trials, the fleet seeking the medicine of immortality was able to behold the visage of the celestial being. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.\n\n"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

promotion_cost_list.name: Sprout of Life
promotion_cost_list.description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

promotion_cost_list.name: Immortal Aeroblossom
promotion_cost_list.description: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After endless trials, the fleet seeking the medicine of immortality was able to behold the visage of the celestial being. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.\n\n"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

requirements.name: Flower of Eternity
requirements.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

requirements.name: Immortal Lumintwig
requirements.description: Deciduous twigs from an ancient divine construct. Advanced material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: Deciduous twigs from an ancient divine construct. Advanced material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After the Three Sufferings, Xianzhou laid in devastation. The Homo celestinae fell as demons, and catastrophes occurred ceaselessly.\n\n"As decreed by the Ten-Lords Commission, all who are near the mara-struck state will be seized by the infernal judges and cast into the Shackling Prison."

item.item_bg_desc: It may be a large shield, but it feels as light as a feather. Even after taking on a full charge, no marks can be seen on the face of the shield. item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. requirements.name: Flower of Ālaya
requirements.description: This is another form for life to exist and a substance that the universe cannot forget. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Remembrance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: This is another form for life to exist and a substance that the universe cannot forget. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Remembrance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: It matures. It becomes a web that constrains history, a blossom from the past. Life is its flower bed or its pistil. If you become the pistil, then you remember the universe and the universe remembers you. You are memory. \n\n"Memory is the true form of all things, thus there is no creation or annihilation in the Anāśrava pure land."

requirements.name: Glory-Aspersed Torso
requirements.description: The heart of a Strife Titankin, full of divine power. Advanced material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: The heart of a Strife Titankin, full of divine power. Advanced material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: In the beginning, humanity fought wars to stay alive, but now some fight as fearlessly as the Titankins of Strife to achieve death. The Kremnoans say that perhaps warriors of flesh and stone share the same heart —\n\n"And this heart is called glory, with courage flowing within."

item.item_desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A crude material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: In the primal wilds, a mother asked her child, "Did you break your father's bow?" The child answered, "No, it must have been someone else." "No one else has ever stepped foot in this cave," the mother said. "If it wasn't you, then it must have been me." The child continued, "A gremlin did it. I saw it with my own eyes, but only kids can see them, so that's why you didn't." The mother laughed. "Fine then, why would a gremlin break your father's bow?" The child said calmly, "Father probably stepped on its nest. You adults can't see gremlins, so you're always breaking their homes." Whether this talk actually happened is irrelevant. The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child. For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world. "With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

requirements.description: Fluffy Across the Blue in its storyboard stage. Slightly increases the Traces of Elation characters.

item.item_desc: Fluffy Across the Blue in its storyboard stage. Slightly increases the Traces of Elation characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Blurry is an incredibly fast artist who can draw a month's worth of work in a single day. But they never do, claiming they need to "guarantee quality," though they're likely just allergic to work. "It's so weird... how are there so many identical manuscripts of 'The Fluffy' out there, and every single one is clearly an original? Is Blurry selling these to make a quick buck?" "No way! Blurry is just a perfectionist who draws every page ten times until it's exactly right."

requirements.description: Fluffy Across the Blue currently in magazine serialization. Moderately increases the Traces of Elation characters.

item.item_desc: Fluffy Across the Blue currently in magazine serialization. Moderately increases the Traces of Elation characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Rumor has it that a Phantasmoon Games winner once accelerated time, leaving every artist in Planarcadia unable to meet their deadlines, except for Blurry. This is clearly just a tabloid story, and knowing them, QR_Colt probably wrote it themselves.\n\n"I was born drawing as well as Graphia, but it took me an entire lifetime to learn how to draw as fast as a Bullet Wyrm." — QR_Colt, during an online interview

requirements.name: Dreamweave Steel
requirements.description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: Remember the old story? An officer pointed at a painting that exposed his atrocities and asked, "Did you paint this?" The artist smiled and replied, "No, you did." Art that tries to represent reality cannot simply copy it. The shallow surface of reality can never capture its profound, intangible essence. Consider a fallen soldier. If you only paint their likeness, they are just one more face among the nameless dead. But if you look past the surface to find the invisible honor, courage, rage, and regret, that is when you truly reach their reality. Only then will people know that this soldier was not just another statistic. This was someone who once brought the pulse of life to the mountains, the waters, and the homes they left behind. "With stories, we are able to fight back against evil."

item_comefrom.desc: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 2

item.item_bg_desc: In the primal wilds, a mother asked her child, "Did you break your father's bow?" The child answered, "No, it must have been someone else." "No one else has ever stepped foot in this cave," the mother said. "If it wasn't you, then it must have been me." The child continued, "A gremlin did it. I saw it with my own eyes, but only kids can see them, so that's why you didn't." The mother laughed. "Fine then, why would a gremlin break your father's bow?" The child said calmly, "Father probably stepped on its nest. You adults can't see gremlins, so you're always breaking their homes." Whether this talk actually happened is irrelevant. The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child. For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world. "With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

There are always regrets, always moments wasted. But luckily, we have stories. In stories, creators and readers share a different life. In stories, the human experience is continuously extended. name: Post-Op Conversation
description: "You're awake... Thank you." "You... saved my life, Natasha. The one who should be saying thanks... is me." "No, I should be thanking you... for holding on until I finished the surgery." The doctor and patient smiled wearily at each other and said nothing more.

requirements.description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

requirements.name: Flower of Eternity
requirements.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

item.item_desc: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Advanced material used for enhancement.

summary.en: Day One of My New Life
summary.desc: "So happy I got to see Pom-Pom in new clothes today! I like it~" "Today's my birthday! I'm still as cute as ever." "Today, I finally finally finally have a junior! Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?" We click the shutter many times without thinking. Do we do that to capture the happiness at that moment? Or to capture ourselves at that moment?

refinements.name: At This Very Moment
refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's DEF by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

name: Only Silence Remains
description: "Shouldn't we get off? It's our stop." A chuckle came from above. His eyes moved, but he didn't look up. "To be clear, March always says you're expressionless, but I don't agree." "The train's data bank show traces of an update, but the results weren't saved." "So... which entry were you having trouble with?" He grasped his pen tighter as he looked at the bloody scene drawn in the notebook from memory. "I see. It was the one about you..."

item.item_desc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind. Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy. "The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."

summary.desc: "Shouldn't we get off? It's our stop." A chuckle came from above. His eyes moved, but he didn't look up. "To be clear, March always says you're expressionless, but I don't agree." "The train's data bank show traces of an update, but the results weren't saved." "So... which entry were you having trouble with?" He grasped his pen tighter as he looked at the bloody scene drawn in the notebook from memory. "I see. It was the one about you..."

detail.name: Only Silence Remains
detail.desc: "Shouldn't we get off? It's our stop." A chuckle came from above. His eyes moved, but he didn't look up. "To be clear, March always says you're expressionless, but I don't agree." "The train's data bank show traces of an update, but the results weren't saved." "So... which entry were you having trouble with?" He grasped his pen tighter as he looked at the bloody scene drawn in the notebook from memory. "I see. It was the one about you..."

name: The Birth of the Self
description: In the beginning, it had the exact same pose as the previous portrait. Looking at the face identical to hers, she was convinced that this was not her. "Impossible. How can two portraits be exactly the same?" She tweaked its joints, opened its eyes, and made its fingers softer. She looked happy when all the changes were done. "Completely different from yesterday. This is more like who I am today."

item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. summary.desc: In the beginning, it had the exact same pose as the previous portrait. Looking at the face identical to hers, she was convinced that this was not her. "Impossible. How can two portraits be exactly the same?" She tweaked its joints, opened its eyes, and made its fingers softer. She looked happy when all the changes were done. "Completely different from yesterday. This is more like who I am today."

detail.name: The Birth of the Self
detail.desc: In the beginning, it had the exact same pose as the previous portrait. Looking at the face identical to hers, she was convinced that this was not her. "Impossible. How can two portraits be exactly the same?" She tweaked its joints, opened its eyes, and made its fingers softer. She looked happy when all the changes were done. "Completely different from yesterday. This is more like who I am today."

refinements.name: The Maiden in the Painting
refinements.desc: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATKs by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. If the current HP percentage of the enemy target is below or equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATKs by an extra <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.

name: Shared Feeling
description:
When the doctor found the wounded girl, she was clinging to a machine that had stopped working, with all sorts of parts filling her pocket.
She took the girl back to her clinic and treated the wounds.
Drops of sweat slowly rolled down the girl's cheek, but she remained silent and her hands didn't stop fiddling the machine.
To the doctor, the way the girl was attached to the machine was very much like how she was attached to her patients who needed help.
So the doctor did not try to comfort the girl nor did she nag her about being more careful; but rather, she sat down with her to give her a moment of peace.

item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

summary.desc:
When the doctor found the wounded girl, she was clinging to a machine that had stopped working, with all sorts of parts filling her pocket.
She took the girl back to her clinic and treated the wounds.
Drops of sweat slowly rolled down the girl's cheek, but she remained silent and her hands didn't stop fiddling the machine.
To the doctor, the way the girl was attached to the machine was very much like how she was attached to her patients who needed help.
So the doctor did not try to comfort the girl nor did she nag her about being more careful; but rather, she sat down with her to give her a moment of peace.

name: Eyes of the Prey
description: In reality, most prey don't realize when danger is encroaching. This one's no exception. The sniper's scope slowly centers on a man throwing banknotes stack after stack, who seems completely oblivious to his impending demise. "So that's what greed looks like. That amount is equal to several of my contracts already... No wonder someone wants him dead." As if these thoughts were broadcasted out loud, the man in the scope turns his head, looking straight into the eyes of the sniper. "I've been waiting for you. Would this much be enough for you to hear me out?"

name: Landau's Choice
description: "Did you not hear me? Don't go there ever again! What could you possibly be learning from those commoners!" "But I've never heard any of the stories they tell about Belobog before..." She pulled her brother behind her, denying him the chance to talk back. "You are both Landaus! One day, you'll face hard choices. Especially you, Serval." She knew that her brother did nothing wrong, but she couldn't think of a rebuttal. She went to bed angry after the argument, vowing to herself: "I will be a grown-up one day. And when that day comes, I will make choices..." "My own choices..."

summary.desc: "Did you not hear me? Don't go there ever again! What could you possibly be learning from those commoners!" "But I've never heard any of the stories they tell about Belobog before..." She pulled her brother behind her, denying him the chance to talk back. "You are both Landaus! One day, you'll face hard choices. Especially you, Serval." She knew that her brother did nothing wrong, but she couldn't think of a rebuttal. She went to bed angry after the argument, vowing to herself: "I will be a grown-up one day. And when that day comes, I will make choices..." "My own choices..."
summary.ja: ランドゥーの{RUBY_B#せんたく}選択{RUBY_E#}

detail.name: Landau's Choice
detail.desc: "Did you not hear me? Don't go there ever again! What could you possibly be learning from those commoners!" "But I've never heard any of the stories they tell about Belobog before..." She pulled her brother behind her, denying him the chance to talk back. "You are both Landaus! One day, you'll face hard choices. Especially you, Serval." She knew that her brother did nothing wrong, but she couldn't think of a rebuttal. She went to bed angry after the argument, vowing to herself: "I will be a grown-up one day. And when that day comes, I will make choices..." "My own choices..."

refinements.name: Time Fleets Away
refinements.desc: The wearer is more likely to be attacked, and DMG taken is reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

name: Swordplay
description:
Looking rather skeptical, the girl thrust the small sword at her imaginary enemy in an attempt to convince herself that this thing was useful.
How can something so feeble compete with my two-handed sword? Do enemies even notice when they get stabbed?

The owner of the sword did not seem to care about its size.
After all, enemies are defeated by strategy, not swords.
It doesn't matter whether the sword is heavy or light, as long as you use the pointy end.

summary.desc:
Looking rather skeptical, the girl thrust the small sword at her imaginary enemy in an attempt to convince herself that this thing was useful.
How can something so feeble compete with my two-handed sword? Do enemies even notice when they get stabbed?

The owner of the sword did not seem to care about its size.
After all, enemies are defeated by strategy, not swords.
It doesn't matter whether the sword is heavy or light, as long as you use the pointy end.

refinements.name: Answers of Their Own
refinements.desc: For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.

name: Planetary Rendezvous
description: She had no idea what to expect when she first started out on this journey. All she knew was that she could at long last be rid of the judgmental eyes and petty bickering of her family. She felt she finally understood what the poet was trying to say. "One day, we would grow wings and forget what it was like to walk." The light in her eyes became the glittering stars.

name: A Secret Vow
description:
The boy would always make sure that his gloves and elbow guards were in good shape before leaving.
He treasured his gloves more than anything because they were tight enough to hide secrets.
With this layer of protection, no one could see the bandages on his hand and the wound beneath them.
He would be treated as if he was normal, and he would be greeted just like everyone else.

That was all he asked for.

requirements.description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. I woke up realizing that this is the answer I've been looking for all along!"

requirements.description: Mechanical spindle left behind from the Old World. Normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: Mechanical spindle left behind from the Old World. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: Once taken apart, the precision components can never be put back together. Even the maintenance veterans in Belobog's Technology Division would think twice before touching it.\n\n"You idiot, the Bluecoats will only give you a few canned goods for this. Take it to Boss Svarog and you won't need to worry about food and clothing for a while."

requirements.name: Key of Wisdom
requirements.description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: This is the proof of invitation to the halls of the Nous Temple. Finding the door of which this key opens is a far more arduous task than obtaining the key itself. Those who pass through the doors will immediately realize the impossibility of returning to this side. "The Erudition does not have answers to the universe, but it will teach you how to ask the right questions."

requirements.name: Ancient Engine
requirements.description: Mechanical engine left behind from the Old World. Advanced material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: Mechanical engine left behind from the Old World. Advanced material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: It uses Geomarrow as the energy source. When powered, it spews wandering auroras, not sparkles.\n\n"Only the Technology Division directly under the Supreme Guardian has access to information regarding the Old World. I lost my privileges after I was fired."

detail.name: Make the World Clamor
detail.desc: She stood on the stage, waving at her audience, encouraging them to make their voice heard. Songs, shouts, or laments — anything that makes a sound. Voice your thoughts, so others can come to help. "Don't make your heart as cold as this concrete jungle." — Make the world clamor.

refinements.name: The Power of Sound
refinements.desc: The wearer regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Energy immediately upon entering battle, and increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Ultimate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

name: Perfect Timing
description: On a bustling street, he walks and walks. The sunlight closely follows his footsteps.\nHe makes a stop and picks up an umbrella to shade himself from the sun\n...and from that prying gaze.

Outgoing Healing can be increased this way by up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.

item.item_bg_desc: The foundation of Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The smallest constituent of all machine parts. requirements.name: Sprout of Life
requirements.description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

requirements.name: Artifex's Cogwheel
requirements.description: Parts of the Xianzhou machines. Normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: Parts of the Xianzhou machines. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The connective components used in Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The intricate and thin teeth of the cogwheels are as minute as mustard seeds, and yet are interconnected to form a complex body, making the machine able to pass as true life.\n\n"Its form lies in harmony, a parallel to nature. Its movements cyclical, echoing the cosmos."

requirements.description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

item.item_desc: Parts of the Xianzhou machines. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The connective components used in Xianzhou's ingenium technology. Its movements cyclical, echoing the cosmos."

requirements.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

requirements.description: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Advanced material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Advanced material used for enhancement.

The armillary sphere roils and vibrates like the essence of a heart, making the machine think like a living being.\n\n"Do not be startled. Taking away its heart would make him... her?... No, make it lose its sentience and return to its mechanical sources."

refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and increases Outgoing Healing by an amount that is equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Effect RES. name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat
description:
The limelight cast on the boxing ring is bright, but no brighter than all those beads of sweat running down his back.

He has long been determined to use his two fists to protect those he cherishes the most.
After all, they are the ones who ignited his determination in the first place.
They are the ones who have always been there for him, be it inside or outside the boxing ring.

effect.description: When the wearer hits an enemy and if the hit enemy is not already "Ensnared," then there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> base chance to "Ensnare" the hit enemy. "Ensnared" enemies' DEF decreases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

summary.en: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat
summary.desc:
The limelight cast on the boxing ring is bright, but no brighter than all those beads of sweat running down his back.

He has long been determined to use his two fists to protect those he cherishes the most.
After all, they are the ones who ignited his determination in the first place.
They are the ones who have always been there for him, be it inside or outside the boxing ring.

name: Subscribe for More!
description: "Yo, yo. What is up! Is everything coming through?" The orange-haired girl slowly lifts a sledgehammer while shouting enthusiastically at the camera. "Ever seen a pretty girl doing the cinder-block-smashed-on-chest stunt?" "I didn't sign up for this!" The brunette girl cried out loud, only to be met with a sly smile from the girl with the orange hair. "Please. Just let me do this. This is what people would've wanted."

item.item_bg_desc: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? name: Dance! Dance! Dance!
description: "Why couldn't Hook do a spinning dance move, just like how Clara does?" She clenched her tiny fists and pouted her cute lips, her chubby little face looking redder than ever under her signature felt hat. "Please, Mr. Svarog, can you please help Hook with this?" Without saying any words, Mr. Svarog began to hold out his robotic arm. "I'm g—gonna be sick!!! Put me down now! Please!"

"If you know Screwllum, then these two millions are basically yours to take..."

summary.desc: "Why couldn't Hook do a spinning dance move, just like how Clara does?" She clenched her tiny fists and pouted her cute lips, her chubby little face looking redder than ever under her signature felt hat. "Please, Mr. Svarog, can you please help Hook with this?" Without saying any words, Mr. Svarog began to hold out his robotic arm. "I'm g—gonna be sick!!! Put me down now! Please!"
summary.ja: ダンス！ダンス！ダンス！

detail.name: Dance! Dance! Dance!
detail.desc: "Why couldn't Hook do a spinning dance move, just like how Clara does?" She clenched her tiny fists and pouted her cute lips, her chubby little face looking redder than ever under her signature felt hat. "Please, Mr. Svarog, can you please help Hook with this?" Without saying any words, Mr. Svarog began to hold out his robotic arm. "I'm g—gonna be sick!!! Put me down now! Please!"

refinements.name: Cannot Stop It!
refinements.desc: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

name: Under the Blue Sky
description:
Under the blue sky, fields of wheat were dancing.
The young girl was carefully weaving a flower wreath,
for her most beloved little sister.

That was when they were still the same height.
That was when they shared the same smile.

item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "infinite lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. Countless years ago, a sovereign's hubris for immortality caused the Xianzhou fleet to sail into the sea of outer space to seek divine recipes.\n\n"We desire to live for endless ages and maintain the empire for all eternity. Unfortunately, human lives have limits and human capacity has its ends. Thus, we send nine Navis Astrigera to sail beyond the sky, seeking divine recipes for immortality."

item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.\n\n"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

summary.desc:
Under the blue sky, fields of wheat were dancing.
The young girl was carefully weaving a flower wreath,
for her most beloved little sister.

That was when they were still the same height.
That was when they shared the same smile.

name: Geniuses' Repose
description: She pointed at that green rice cake. "The experiment has ended. Time to take a break. I just can't miss this freshly made dessert." She saw the puppet girl frowning in deep thought. "Well, in your current body, you can only look but not eat. I'll make you a box of new ones when the time comes." She saw the mechanical aristocrat hesitating at his own cup. "Don't worry. It's only machine oil. Perfectly safe for you to consume."

item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. summary.desc: She pointed at that green rice cake. "The experiment has ended. Time to take a break. I just can't miss this freshly made dessert." She saw the puppet girl frowning in deep thought. "Well, in your current body, you can only look but not eat. I'll make you a box of new ones when the time comes." She saw the mechanical aristocrat hesitating at his own cup. "Don't worry. It's only machine oil. Perfectly safe for you to consume."

name: Quid Pro Quo
description: After enjoying an intense massage from the dragon girl, the foxian girl held out her hand and playfully pinched the dragon girl's little chubby cheeks. The little girl then pouted her lips, clearly offended, only to elicit a gleeful giggle from the foxian girl. "Now that's what I call a proper quid pro quo."

requirements.description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

item.item_desc: Military rank insignia worn by captains of the Silvermane Guard. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: Maybe it's a proof of heroics that you can brag about to your family. Maybe it's a lucky charm that protects you from a bullet.\n\n"Times have changed."

requirements.name: Flower of Eternity
requirements.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

requirements.name: Silvermane Medal
requirements.description: Medal of honor worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards with gallant and meritorious service. Advanced material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: Medal of honor worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards with gallant and meritorious service. Advanced material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: A proof of honor awarded to those that fought against Fragmentum creatures, Underworlders, and sudden disasters. It is not usually pinned onto the recipient's chest, but rather placed onto his coffin. "Remember, young Gepard. It is not a toy: It is the destiny and blood of the Landau family."

name: Fermata
description: The phonograph record is being played, spinning nonstop. Even the sounds of all those hoarse shrieks cannot escape the heatwave and are dampened by its tepidity. She seemed unprepared and utterly enthralled by the fascinating melodies: It started with sincerity and anticipation... ...followed by a passionate catharsis... ...with one climax after another... ...until the record's spinning came to a final stop and those hoarse shrieks were no longer audible. "Mission accomplished."

summary.desc: The phonograph record is being played, spinning nonstop. Even the sounds of all those hoarse shrieks cannot escape the heatwave and are dampened by its tepidity. She seemed unprepared and utterly enthralled by the fascinating melodies: It started with sincerity and anticipation... ...followed by a passionate catharsis... ...with one climax after another... ...until the record's spinning came to a final stop and those hoarse shrieks were no longer audible. "Mission accomplished."

name: We Are Wildfire
description: She got used to people losing their homes. And she got used to people losing their lives. But crying alone was useless. "Wear this red scarf, and then we shall share each other's pain." "We are family. We are Wildfire." The moment that pair of big hands held her head, she could no longer hold back her tears.

At the same time, immediately restores HP to all allies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the respective HP difference between the characters' Max HP and current HP.

summary.desc: She got used to people losing their homes. And she got used to people losing their lives. But crying alone was useless. "Wear this red scarf, and then we shall share each other's pain." "We are family. We are Wildfire." The moment that pair of big hands held her head, she could no longer hold back her tears.

detail.name: We Are Wildfire
detail.desc: She got used to people losing their homes. And she got used to people losing their lives. But crying alone was useless. "Wear this red scarf, and then we shall share each other's pain." "We are family. We are Wildfire." The moment that pair of big hands held her head, she could no longer hold back her tears.

refinements.name: Teary-Eyed
refinements.desc: At the start of the battle, the DMG dealt to all allies decreases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). At the same time, immediately restores HP to all allies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the respective HP difference between the characters' Max HP and current HP.

name: River Flows in Spring
description: The young boy took a short break from his sword practice.\nThe sunlight was baking his already heated neck. He slowly got into the water, whose coldness touched his bare feet.\nWhen the bell chimes and birds tweet, even the people far away would know that springtime had arrived.

requirements.name: Arrow of the Starchaser
requirements.description: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind. Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy. "The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."

name: Past and Future
description: The wings of the paper kite in her hands were broken, brutally reminding her of her beloved's tragic passing. She kneeled next to the fire of war, eyes full of sorrow. "If you are the only one left to do this, then our sacrifice would..." Gunfire raged on, painting the sky red without dampening its majesty. She looked up at the sky, eyes full of fury.

name: Woof! Walk Time!
description:
Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it screw up its nose and sniff around and dive into an empty path.

Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it retract its claws, enter the password, and leap into the embraces of freedom.

Has nobody seen it still...?
A grown dog can now walk itself in space!

summary.desc:
Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it screw up its nose and sniff around and dive into an empty path.

Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it retract its claws, enter the password, and leap into the embraces of freedom.

Has nobody seen it still...?
A grown dog can now walk itself in space!
summary.ja: ワン！{RUBY_B#さんぽ}散歩{RUBY_E#}の{RUBY_B#じかん}時間{RUBY_E#}！

detail.name: Woof! Walk Time!
detail.desc:
Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it screw up its nose and sniff around and dive into an empty path.

Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it retract its claws, enter the password, and leap into the embraces of freedom.

Has nobody seen it still...?
A grown dog can now walk itself in space!

refinements.name: Run!
refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, and increases their DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn or Bleed by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This also applies to DoT.

name: The Seriousness of Breakfast
description: Though the table is set... Some people want a cup of tea first. Some people want to take a picture first. Some people want to read the newspaper first. Some people want to write a page in their notebook first. Some people want to play on their phone first. "All of you, eat while the food is hot!"

refinements.name: Get Ready
refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s).

name: Warmth Shortens Cold Nights
description:
Lighting a light, she glanced at her friend beside her while holding a mug of warm chocolate.
Watching her read the books and notes she gifted her.
Watching her expressing a rare smile.

In cold nights like this, even the tiniest bit of bliss can chase away the chills.

item.item_bg_desc: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

promotion_cost_list.description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

item.item_desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

summary.desc:
Lighting a light, she glanced at her friend beside her while holding a mug of warm chocolate.
Watching her read the books and notes she gifted her.
Watching her expressing a rare smile.

In cold nights like this, even the tiniest bit of bliss can chase away the chills.

name: We Will Meet Again
description: She had once thought it was some sort of program. How else would it never tire? But a program would never actively discard the optimal solution and bypass her trap. "Seems like we'll have a war of attrition." She yawns. "Time to sleep. Organic lifeforms should treasure rest." The surroundings dim. She suddenly bolts awake, but the residues of data are swept away and destroyed. It all seems like a dream — but the taste of defeat is very real.

name: This Is Me!
description: The girl could rock any outfit she chooses, but she was unsatisfied, judging by the dozen sets of clothing piled up behind her. "Will this be the last outfit for today?" She thought silently to herself and looked at the girl in the mirror. She looked extra happy on this day. "Okay! This is me!"

summary.desc: The girl could rock any outfit she chooses, but she was unsatisfied, judging by the dozen sets of clothing piled up behind her. "Will this be the last outfit for today?" She thought silently to herself and looked at the girl in the mirror. She looked extra happy on this day. "Okay! This is me!"
summary.ja: これがウチだよ！

detail.name: This Is Me!
detail.desc: The girl could rock any outfit she chooses, but she was unsatisfied, judging by the dozen sets of clothing piled up behind her. "Will this be the last outfit for today?" She thought silently to herself and looked at the girl in the mirror. She looked extra happy on this day. "Okay! This is me!"

refinements.name: New Chapter
refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's DEF by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Increases the DMG of the wearer when they use their Ultimate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the wearer's DEF. This effect only applies 1 time per enemy target during each use of the wearer's Ultimate.

name: Return to Darkness
description: Even though her sister was close by her side, she could hear nothing. The only thing audible was the voice in the depths of her heart, which only grew louder by the minute. "Big sis's body is cold." "Big sis's body is not moving." A violent surge of fury irrevocably overwhelmed her so much that she didn't even find the time to clear her mind, or to remember this crucial yet neglected fact... "Big sis's body has been cold like this for a very long time."

effect.name: Raging Waves
effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After a CRIT Hit, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> fixed chance to dispel 1 buff on the target enemy. This effect can only trigger 1 time per attack.

In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

item.item_desc: An arrowhead forged with Stellaris Essence by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
item.item_bg_desc: An arrow narrower than a finger's width. It can be loaded into an electromagnetic crossbow or a thermal seeking bow as ammunition. Its power is enough to penetrate the tough shells of abominations with just one strike.\n\n"The celestial banished arrives from afar, great distances journeyed 'twixt oceans of stars. Like rain falls a cloudburst of arrows below, in a helmet reflected the bright lunar glow."

promotion_cost_list.name: Immortal Aeroblossom
promotion_cost_list.description: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.

item.item_desc: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.
item.item_bg_desc: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After endless trials, the fleet seeking the medicine of immortality was able to behold the visage of the celestial being. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.\n\n"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

summary.desc: Even though her sister was close by her side, she could hear nothing. The only thing audible was the voice in the depths of her heart, which only grew louder by the minute. "Big sis's body is cold." "Big sis's body is not moving." A violent surge of fury irrevocably overwhelmed her so much that she didn't even find the time to clear her mind, or to remember this crucial yet neglected fact... "Big sis's body has been cold like this for a very long time."
summary.ja: {RUBY_B#ゆうめい}幽冥{RUBY_E#}に{RUBY_B#き}帰{RUBY_E#}す

detail.name: Return to Darkness
detail.desc: Even though her sister was close by her side, she could hear nothing. The only thing audible was the voice in the depths of her heart, which only grew louder by the minute. "Big sis's body is cold." "Big sis's body is not moving." A violent surge of fury irrevocably overwhelmed her so much that she didn't even find the time to clear her mind, or to remember this crucial yet neglected fact... "Big sis's body has been cold like this for a very long time."

refinements.name: Raging Waves
refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After a CRIT Hit, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> fixed chance to dispel 1 buff on the target enemy. This effect can only trigger 1 time per attack.

name: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds
description: He immediately falls in love with the golden vessel and is about to buy it, but the foxian girl drags him aside and whispers: "Please return at night, Mr. Benefactor, and make up your mind then." As promised, he returns at night. The same foxian girl opens the door and smiles at him. "Please follow me, Mr. Benefactor." A ray of moonlight shines onto the base of the etched plate. The artisan had traced the petals with lines of various depths, and he would not be able to see such details without the moonlight. He finally recalls why this item is called "Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds."

effect.name: Secret
effect.description: At the start of the battle and whenever the wearer's turn begins, one of the following effects is applied randomly: All allies' ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, all allies' CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, or all allies' Energy Regeneration Rate increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. The applied effect cannot be identical to the last effect applied, and will replace the previous effect. The applied effect will be removed when the wearer has been knocked down. Effects of the same type cannot be stacked.

summary.en: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds
summary.desc: He immediately falls in love with the golden vessel and is about to buy it, but the foxian girl drags him aside and whispers: "Please return at night, Mr. Benefactor, and make up your mind then." As promised, he returns at night. The same foxian girl opens the door and smiles at him. "Please follow me, Mr. Benefactor." A ray of moonlight shines onto the base of the etched plate. The artisan had traced the petals with lines of various depths, and he would not be able to see such details without the moonlight. He finally recalls why this item is called "Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds."

refinements.name: Secret
refinements.desc: At the start of the battle and whenever the wearer's turn begins, one of the following effects is applied randomly: All allies' ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, all allies' CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, or all allies' Energy Regeneration Rate increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. The applied effect cannot be identical to the last effect applied, and will replace the previous effect. The applied effect will be removed when the wearer has been knocked down. Effects of the same type cannot be stacked.

name: Nowhere to Run
description:

Though he wants to run away, there is nowhere to run.

item.item_bg_desc: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. summary.desc: There is the new book borrowed for lunch and she just figured out a new way to play tiles. If she works slowly, the rest of her job should last exactly till the end of day. She ducks easily into a corner. No one must disturb her in her wonderful off time — not even diviner Fu. Just on the off chance that she does show up... "Then I'll give this milk candy ball to Diviner Fu. She can't be angry after having sweets!"
summary.ja: {RUBY_B#きょう}今日{RUBY_E#}も{RUBY_B#へいわ}平和{RUBY_E#}な{RUBY_B#いちにち}一日{RUBY_E#}

detail.name: Today Is Another Peaceful Day
detail.desc: There is the new book borrowed for lunch and she just figured out a new way to play tiles. If she works slowly, the rest of her job should last exactly till the end of day. She ducks easily into a corner. No one must disturb her in her wonderful off time — not even diviner Fu. Just on the off chance that she does show up... "Then I'll give this milk candy ball to Diviner Fu. She can't be angry after having sweets!"

refinements.name: A Storm Is Coming
refinements.desc: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f2]%</unbreak></color>. A max of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy will be taken into account for this.

name: What Is Real?
description: "If all the clocks are displaying the wrong time..." "If those bound to promises fulfilled their vows through betrayal..." "If those who sink into the realm of dreams never truly fell asleep..." "If the dead return to life, only to discover their names have been stripped..." "If... if..." He blows out the flame, and in darkness, there is but the eternal ticking of the timepiece.

effect.name: Hypothesis
effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using Basic ATK, restores HP for the wearer by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP plus <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using Basic ATK, restores HP for the wearer by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP plus <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

name: Dreamville Adventure
description: "Hello, dear viewers! Clockie and his pals have come to see you all again!" "In the previous episode, Boss Stone discovered that Dreamville was sitting on a wealth of natural resources, and moved to seize control over the city. In response, Clockie joined forces with Brother Hanu and Origami Bird, and together, they sent Boss Stone and his goons running from Dreamville." "But Boss Stone isn't going to be defeated that easily, and this time, he's gathered a legion of thugs to fulfill his oath of turning Dreamville into a crater. In this episode, Clockie might just be standing against the greatest threat he ever faced!" "What scheme will Clockie employ to escape from this crisis? And what new friends will join his party? Stay tuned for the latest episode of 'Dreamville Adventure'!"

effect.name: Solidarity
effect.description: After the wearer uses a certain type of ability such as Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, all allies gain Childishness, which increases allies' DMG for the same type of ability as used by the wearer by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Childishness only takes effect for the most recent type of ability the wearer used and cannot be stacked.

name: Final Victor
description: "You don't believe me?" He provocatively looks at the man before him, then draws out a revolver, empties its cylinder, and leaves a single shot in the chamber. "Seems like I'll need to get you up to speed on how I do things if our cooperation were to remain amicable." He pushes the gun into his opponent's hand, spins the cylinder, and points the barrel to his own chest. He pulls the trigger repeatedly, and the smile on his face remains the same after three empty clicks. "Life is a grand gamble, and I'll always be the final victor."

name: Flames Afar
description: "Package secured. I'll leave covering our retreat to you." Their comrade's voice comes through the communicator. They glance around the surroundings, watching as the savaged remnants of their enemies continue to pass through the complex architecture inside the vast and abandoned structure. They are drawing ever closer. "Please hold." After a beat of quietude, a series of apocalyptic explosions rocket up into the sky. Waves of displaced air cast clouds of dust high across the battlefield, and smoke scatter in all directions, the blinding white cleaving light into the night. "You know they purposely planted loads of gunpowder in there, right?" With a rustle, they flung open the cape as if they just finished a leisurely stroll. "Of course." "So, let's light it up. All I need to do is play the part of the match."

summary.desc: "Package secured. I'll leave covering our retreat to you." Their comrade's voice comes through the communicator. They glance around the surroundings, watching as the savaged remnants of their enemies continue to pass through the complex architecture inside the vast and abandoned structure. They are drawing ever closer. "Please hold." After a beat of quietude, a series of apocalyptic explosions rocket up into the sky. Waves of displaced air cast clouds of dust high across the battlefield, and smoke scatter in all directions, the blinding white cleaving light into the night. "You know they purposely planted loads of gunpowder in there, right?" With a rustle, they flung open the cape as if they just finished a leisurely stroll. "Of course." "So, let's light it up. All I need to do is play the part of the match."

refinements.name: Deflagration
refinements.desc: When the wearer's cumulative HP loss during one attack exceeds <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, or if the amount of their own HP consumed at one time is greater than <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, immediately heals the wearer for <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and at the same time, increases the DMG they deal by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

name: Destiny's Threads Forewoven
description: Destiny always tows the masses onward without reason, and she lurks within the darkness, waiting to inscribe the most crucial of instants. Sorting, matching, shuffling, drawing... She simulates fate's hand in how it manipulates all variables for the masses, seeking the trajectory of truth beneath the visage of a disorderly exterior. Finally, when all the characters are in their place, she brushes over the card faces that are in stasis and assembles the unfathomable truth. "Still missing a card... So, I'll add one in."

summary.desc: Destiny always tows the masses onward without reason, and she lurks within the darkness, waiting to inscribe the most crucial of instants. Sorting, matching, shuffling, drawing... She simulates fate's hand in how it manipulates all variables for the masses, seeking the trajectory of truth beneath the visage of a disorderly exterior. Finally, when all the characters are in their place, she brushes over the card faces that are in stasis and assembles the unfathomable truth. "Still missing a card... So, I'll add one in."

refinements.name: Insight
refinements.desc: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. For every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> of DEF the wearer has, increases the wearer's DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>, up to a maximum DMG increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>.

name: The Day The Cosmos Fell
description: "Molten Cheese Tart! You are in charge of disarming the planet's lookouts with your charm!" "Gray Bean Paste! You will be in charge of breaching the planet's line of defense!" "Salty Rimeplume! Bring us the head of the planet's leader!" "My lord, what are you going to do!" "I shall pretend to be an adorable kitten to befuddle these stupid humans!" That day, the Cosmos remembered... the terror of being ruled by them.

effect.name: Stratagem
effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When the wearer uses an attack and at least 2 attacked enemies have the corresponding Weakness, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

name: Indelible Promise
description: A weathered past. A sworn duty to defend home. A dream to blaze a trail across the world— These were entrusted to the unworldly youth by a pair of rough, calloused hands. "Soon, we'll be able to go to a larger world." The boy happily accepted his inheritance. Guarded by youth, he could not yet feel the weight born by the object's significance. "Of course. Before that time comes, however, guard this place well, Misha." He thus engraved that promise deep inside his heart, holding to it forever and always.

summary.desc: A weathered past. A sworn duty to defend home. A dream to blaze a trail across the world— These were entrusted to the unworldly youth by a pair of rough, calloused hands. "Soon, we'll be able to go to a larger world." The boy happily accepted his inheritance. Guarded by youth, he could not yet feel the weight born by the object's significance. "Of course. Before that time comes, however, guard this place well, Misha." He thus engraved that promise deep inside his heart, holding to it forever and always.

detail.name: Indelible Promise
detail.desc: A weathered past. A sworn duty to defend home. A dream to blaze a trail across the world— These were entrusted to the unworldly youth by a pair of rough, calloused hands. "Soon, we'll be able to go to a larger world." The boy happily accepted his inheritance. Guarded by youth, he could not yet feel the weight born by the object's significance. "Of course. Before that time comes, however, guard this place well, Misha." He thus engraved that promise deep inside his heart, holding to it forever and always.

name: Concert for Two
description: "Big brother, what's this..." "It's been so long since you sang with joy... I've built a stage for you, though it's... a bit rudimentary." "But the teacher thinks I'm not cut out for this..." "Nonsense, I think you sound amazing! And your dreams will definitely come true. You deserve to sing on a bigger stage..." ... Many years later, she stood on a dazzling stage, looking at the surging fans below, but lost herself for a moment... On the long journey of chasing dreams, she would always remember that trusting gaze and her first "concert." No glamorous lights, no elaborate makeup, just a child building a stage to encourage another child to pursue their dreams. "Now, our dreams have come true. But... are they still 'our' dreams?" She tightened her grip on the microphone. Before the next song began, she didn't even have time to feel sad.
